hooks.command: [ -f .claude/graphify.env ] && command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1 && setsid bash -c 'set -a; . ./.claude/graphify.env; set +a; graphify . --mode deep && graphify cluster-only . && graphify label .' > graphify-out/.hook-deep-update.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
